overview: Corky, a tough female ex con and her lover Violet concoct a scheme to steal millions of stashed mob money and pin the blame on Violet's crooked boyfriend Caeser.
tagline: In their world, you can't buy freedom, but you can steal it.

recs.blurb: An FBI undercover agent infilitrates the mob and finds himself identifying more with the mafia life at the expense of his regular one.
